presentation.name: Venom imprint
presentation.description: Adds the Poison tag and applies 1 Poison stack with base potency 2 for 2 activations.

presentation.name: Efficiency matrix
presentation.description: Reduces this card's Energy cost by 1.

presentation.name: Calibration matrix
presentation.description: Adds 40 percentage points of critical chance to this card's damage effects.

presentation.name: Amplification matrix
presentation.description: Multiplies this card's damage by 1.2 (20% more damage).

presentation.name: Recall link
presentation.description: Adds: draw 1 card after the card's other effects.

presentation.name: Ward link
presentation.description: Adds: gain 4 base Block after the card's other effects.

presentation.name: Ember imprint
presentation.description: Adds the Fire tag and applies 1 Scorch stack with base potency 2 for 2 activations.

presentation.name: Split matrix
presentation.description: Repeats the main effect 3 times and adds the Multihit tag. The shared amount is split across hits.

presentation.name: Cascade link
presentation.description: Carries excess damage to the enemy with the lowest Health, for up to 3 jumps. Additional effects do not jump.

presentation.name: Condensation seal
presentation.description: Replaces the main effect: consume the target's eligible residual stacks and release their accumulated potency in one proc.

presentation.name: Stable matrix
presentation.description: Prevents damage effects from rolling critical tiers.
